capacity.recommended_basis: the minimum plus ~200 GiB growth margin; at the measured 2.74 GiB/day combined ingest that is roughly 70 days of headroom.

capacity_options.name: Expand the data volume
proof_obligations: df on the expanded volume shows free_now >= 403.3 GiB (600 GiB recommended)
the expansion is on the SAME filesystem that holds $G, so publication stays a same-filesystem os.replace
capacity_options.why_preferred: nothing about the storage topology changes, so every path semantic the manifest authority relies on is already proven.

capacity_options.name: External staging / compaction volume
proof_obligations: required free space on the staging volume, measured not assumed
mount persistence across reboot (fstab/systemd unit) and the correct filesystem type; flock is unreliable on NFS (S16-Q15)
atomic publication semantics: os.replace is atomic only WITHIN a filesystem, so a cross-device rename is not a commit point and must not be treated as one
rollback and backup coverage for the staging volume, including whether a whole-VM snapshot covers it -- the WAL anchor domain question in another form
no unsafe cross-filesystem rename assumptions anywhere in the build or publish path
the FINAL block location remains under the manifest root, so segment paths still resolve inside it and the containment guard still holds
capacity_options.why_not_preferred: it introduces a second filesystem into a design whose commit point is a same-filesystem rename. Every obligation above is a way that assumption can silently fail.

deletion_additionally_requires: a recovery/parity policy decision by ops
recovery evidence of one of the three accepted kinds (verified value parity, a recorded external manifest, or an immutable generation with fingerprint provenance)
day-set membership is NOT sufficient: a new block covering the same days proves coverage, never value parity
capacity_scope.does_not_authorize: deletion of the 1267 daily holds, or of any delta backup. The hold audit found 0.0 GiB currently reclaimable, and expanding the real day sets made two entries MORE blocked, not less.
capacity_scope.enables: compaction: the block build and publication can be attempted

compaction_lock_scope.held_from: compaction lock acquisition, before the ingest lock
compaction_lock_scope.why: a compaction reservation released early fences the cheap half of the operation and leaves publish, verify and prune -- the half that mutates the served view -- open to a second compactor.

G3, G4, H7 and G16 are production-dependent and G18 is blocked on disk, so no local synthetic test can turn them green. Waiting for them before authoring the read-only runbook that COLLECTS them is circular: the runbook is the instrument, not the conclusion.
